name: Gemini Computer Use
name_zh: Gemini 计算机操作（Mac 版）
desc: Gemini on Mac that clicks, types and fills forms for you
desc_zh: 在 Mac 上替你点击、输入、填表的 Gemini 功能
solves: Cross-app chores mean hours of clicking through forms; Gemini runs the steps on your Mac while you watch a live preview.
solves_zh: 跨应用办事要花几小时点表单，Gemini 在 Mac 上替你执行，你还能实时预览。
best_for: Forty PDFs need the same fields copied into a legacy desktop app before lunch.
best_for_zh: 四十份 PDF 的同一批字段要在午饭前录进老旧的桌面软件。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：C — https://techcrunch.com/tag/google/ (then D: gemini.google/release-notes)）。 Release updates entry dated 2026.11.19. Rolling out in English for Google AI Plus, Pro and Ultra subscribers (18+, personal accounts) in the U.S. per the release notes; pauses for logins and payments. In-product surface of the Gemini app, not a separate app. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方的说法是一整句「computer use in the Gemini app for Mac」，不适合当卡片标题；缩成产品名加形态。 首次公开日期来源：https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/computer-use-mac/
